material_changes.title: CONTINUITY publishes executable security-context contracts for composed LLM-agent controls
verified_facts: The Sep. 7 cs.CR batch contains arXiv:2609.05269, CONTINUITY: Security-Context Contracts for Composable LLM Agent Controls.
The paper models security-context discontinuity across provenance, authorization, policy, transformation, and finality boundaries and defines end-to-end consequence integrity.
The paper reports a deterministic conformance evaluation spanning 3,460 scenarios and 24,220 system-scenario runs, with 30 regression tests and reproducibility scripts in the public artifact.

The authors explicitly state that these are conformance results under an explicit trusted-computing-base model, not an estimate of real-world attack probability or a claim to solve semantic correctness.
The public zast-ai/continuity repository is non-archived, documents Python 3.11+ reproduction commands, requires no model API key for the deterministic experiment path, and has an MIT root license.
The latest visible repository commit in this pass is 59cfe60930d247d1890b366ded686c718020a11e from September 4, 2026.
missing_verification: Run the artifact's regression tests and quick/full deterministic experiment paths in an isolated local environment.

Record any reproduction delta before adopting controls or capability claims.
